idp.description: The IdP trust block rendered into the apiserver AuthenticationConfiguration. The chart always renders StructuredAuthenticationConfiguration from it.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL. The apiserver fetches JWKS from this issuer's Discovery endpoint at runtime.

audience.description: Mandatory aud value. A trust block without an audience is invalid.

certificateAuthority.description: Optional PEM CA bundle the apiserver trusts when fetching this issuer's Discovery/JWKS over TLS. Omit for a publicly-trusted issuer (Okta, Entra, Google); the system trust store is used. Required only for a self-hosted or bundled issuer whose cert does not chain to a public root, so trusting it stays config, not an apiserver trust-store change.

schedule.description: Cron schedule for the cleanup DeletingPolicies that reap suspended tenants past keepalive and installer leftovers. Standard 5-field cron; Kyverno's minimum granularity is 1 minute.
